design_detail: Utah Population Database linkage: Parkinson's disease/parkinsonism in people with recorded methamphetamine/amphetamine abuse vs. matched population and cocaine comparison groups.
can_establish: Replication of the registry association in a different population and record system.
cannot_establish: Causation; exposure quantification; confounding by smoking and other factors beyond those recorded.

sample.selection_effects: Recorded 'abuse' selects for medical or legal contact.

exposure.measurement: ICD codes in medical records [to be extracted from PDF]

comparison.unmeasured_premorbid: Smoking partially adjusted [to be extracted from PDF]; others not.

analysis.effect_sizes: Approximately threefold hazard ([to be extracted from PDF] exact HR and CI), higher in women [to be extracted from PDF]

risk_of_bias.reasoning: Same design limits as Callaghan et al. (2012).
